messages:
rachel: road-trip throwback needed 1: 40min drive playlist (no EDM) + one ~2hr(ish) quietly weird movie rec. go! :on_the_road:
sam: my 40m drive list (retro/mellow):
1. Tom Petty - Free Fallin' (4:15)
2. Paul Simon - Graceland (4:50)
3. Elvis Costello - Alison (3:20)
4. The Clash - Straight To Hell (6:30)
5. R.E.M. - Nightswimming (4:16)
6. The Kinks - Waterloo Sunset (3:15)
7. Big Star - Thirteen (3:02)
8. Lou Reed - Perfect Day (3:43)

ike: movie rec: "The Straight Story" (David Lynch)  slow, oddly tender, great for windows-down driving vibes, ~112min.
priya: alternative movie: "Wendy and Lucy" if you want intimate + short (~80min).
rachel: love the list. sam, can you swap in Neil Young 1 Harvest Moon if we want more dusk?
sam: yeah swap out The Clash for Harvest Moon. good call.
jukebox-bot: queued sam's adjusted playlist to #random-playlists (link: https://open.spotify/placeholder) :cd:
rachel: vote: Straight Story (car-lull) or Wendy & Lucy (intimate pit stop)? react with :one: for Straight Story, :two: for Wendy
ike: :one:
priya: :two: this time i1m team Wendy
sam: :one: easy pick for driving
rachel: :one: wins. planning a little post-work drive at 7pm. anyone coming?
ike: i'm in 1 bring snacks.
priya: maybe next time 1 got a late call.
